name: Elamipretide (SS-31)
description: Synthetic 4-amino-acid peptide that binds cardiolipin in mitochondria; injected under the skin

note.text: Use for aging is off-label. No trial has tested elamipretide for longevity; a small pilot in adults 65 to 80 is recruiting.

bullets: **Mitochondrial cardiolipin binder** that settles in the inner membrane (label)
**Improves mitochondrial** shape and function, per the label
**In aging,** an effect in people is not established
Approval rests on a 12-person trial and extension
Larger trials mostly missed main goals

practical.halfLife: Not established (not given on the label)
practical.routes: Under the skin (label); IV in some trials
practical.pharmacokinetics: Peak in 0.5 to 1 hour; broken down to inactive peptides; urine
practical.monitored: Allergic reactions, injection sites, eosinophil counts

references: FDA, accelerated approval of first treatment for Barth syndrome, Sep 2025
